lines.text: &fYour own settings for the hub, the chat and the mod's screens. They are kept on this computer and change only what you see.
&7Pick a section on the left. Each option has its name, its control on the right and a line saying what it does.
&7The hub theme, picked from cards that show it in its own colours. The &ffont&7 is a separate choice: vanilla by default, on every theme.
&7How tabs point out news: a badge, a glow or both, and in which colour.
&7Where the tabs sit, whether the window can be dragged (off by default), and whether extra windows close with the hub.
&7Whose deaths and advancements you see (everyone, your team, nobody), Discord messages and Wixie's tips, the &f@mention&7 sound volume, and what each channel's new messages do.
&7The buttons over the chat box: which show, which channels are in &fAll&7, their order, and your own buttons that send through a template.
&7What the tabs point out: new tabs, friend and teleport requests, money, daily quests, auction items, home invites, mail.
&7Who may send you teleport requests. This one is kept by the server.
